# Abstention register

Why a figure may go undisclosed, and what each reason does to the report.

A contract may pre-authorize only the lawful half. An internal failure blocks the
report and can be lifted only by a signed, expiring override — except one, which
cannot be lifted at all.

| code | disposition | effect on the report | basis | overridable to |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `E_CONFIDENTIAL` | lawful_omission | disclosed as an omission | ESRS 1 §35 (classified/sensitive information) | — |
| `E_EVIDENCE_OUT_OF_PERIOD` | internal_failure | **blocks the report** | — | omit_with_material_limitation |
| `E_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE` | internal_failure | **blocks the report** | — | omit_with_material_limitation |
| `E_NOT_APPLICABLE` | lawful_omission | disclosed as an omission | ESRS 1 §34 | — |
| `E_NOT_MATERIAL` | lawful_omission | disclosed as an omission | ESRS 1 §29-33 (double materiality) | — |
| `E_NO_EVIDENCE` | internal_failure | **blocks the report** | — | omit_with_material_limitation |
| `E_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE` | internal_failure | **blocks the report** | — | omit_with_material_limitation, publish_with_qualification |
| `E_PARTIAL_BOUNDARY` | internal_failure | **blocks the report** | — | omit_with_material_limitation |
| `E_PHASE_IN` | lawful_omission | disclosed as an omission | ESRS 1 Appendix C (phase-in provisions) | — |
| `E_RESOLVER_ERROR` | internal_failure | **blocks the report** | — | **nothing — this door has no key** |
| `E_UPSTREAM_QUARANTINE` | internal_failure | **blocks the report** | — | omit_with_material_limitation |

## Override rules

| code | approvals | roles | maximum duration |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| `E_EVIDENCE_OUT_OF_PERIOD` | 1 | audit_committee_chair, chief_financial_officer, data_protection_officer, engagement_partner, head_of_sustainability_reporting | 90 days |
| `E_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE` | 2 | audit_committee_chair, chief_financial_officer, engagement_partner | 180 days |
| `E_NO_EVIDENCE` | 2 | audit_committee_chair, chief_financial_officer, data_protection_officer, engagement_partner, head_of_sustainability_reporting | 90 days |
| `E_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE` | 2 | audit_committee_chair, chief_financial_officer, data_protection_officer, engagement_partner, head_of_sustainability_reporting | 60 days |
| `E_PARTIAL_BOUNDARY` | 2 | audit_committee_chair, chief_financial_officer, data_protection_officer, engagement_partner, head_of_sustainability_reporting | 90 days |
| `E_RESOLVER_ERROR` | — | — | not overridable |
| `E_UPSTREAM_QUARANTINE` | 1 | audit_committee_chair, chief_financial_officer, data_protection_officer, engagement_partner, head_of_sustainability_reporting | 90 days |

Only `E_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE` may be overridden into a *published* figure, because it is the only internal failure where a figure exists at all. Everywhere else the override produces a declared omission.
